VM Reboot Analyzer – HEC44V029774

Window 2026-10-09 00:00–23:59 UTC · user-reported problem start ~09:10 UTC · Region europewest · Source: Azure Strategic Workloads Grafana “Virtual Machine Analyzer” · single capture run HEC44V029774_analyzer_20261009_run_0935

Summary

Most likely cause: an Azure host-side node fault, not a guest failure. The host agent entered a faulted state (NodeFaultCode 70005) after “Preparing host bitlocker volume failed” (FailingHr 0x80004005 E_FAIL, function AddDetailedErrorLogsForDiskEncryption). The platform then moved the VM to a new node/container.

  • Reboot Detail: 2026-10-09 08:58:53 → 2026-10-09 09:09:48 UTC (~10 min 55 s; panel shows 10.9 min). RCA_CSS: Unplanned.NodeFault.AgentFault__InitializationFailed_AddDetailedErrorLogsForDiskEncryption_0. Escalate to RDOS\Azure Host OS DRI – Sev 3-4. Host agent package r_aug_2026.4638b8c.
  • Original node 549d2dc9-e827-46b0-9a1c-83f81af847a7 → replacement node 476a4402-40f9-2d40-fd93-45f573554684 (container 3c9942a0-cc64-4f67-992e-54f8f094499a, placed 09:05:18 UTC), cluster AMS08PrdApp64.
  • SKU Standard_M896ixds_24_v3 (not SAP certified per panel), Linux, 36 attached disks (1 OS + data disks).
  • No data in: ICMs, Outages, Node Storage Error Events, Scheduled Events Detail, Live Migration Events, VM Placement.

Caveats: application downtime and any cluster fencing are not confirmed by this data; the 09:10 time is user-reported; the 08:59 RdAgentUpdater change on the original node is a time correlation only; later events on the original node (~18:xx) do not apply to the VM after it moved.
